meta.title: Nomik — Your home, with a voice of its own
meta.description: Talk to your home: devices and payments that take care of themselves. You just talk.

hero.title: Your home, finally with a voice of its own.
hero.sub: Nomik hears what you need, controls your devices and handles payments. You just talk.

items.title: Natural speech
items.text: Ask the way you'd ask a person.

items.title: Pay only for what you use
items.text: You only pay when something works for you.

items.title: Control your devices
items.text: Ask for what you need and Nomik carries out the allowed actions.

items.title: Always with your permission
items.text: Nothing important moves without your approval.

showcase.title: It remembers your home.
showcase.text: It knows what's in each room, your routines and your schedule. Every conversation picks up where it left off.

showcase.title: You set the rules.
showcase.text: Set how much can be spent, what needs your tap, and when to stop entirely. Nomik always obeys.

showcase.title: Your whole house on one account.
showcase.text: A little box with a microphone and a touch display. They pair with a short code and obey your voice.

items.title: Your account travels with you
items.text: Sign in from any device and everything stays put: your home, your history, your settings.

items.title: Your voice stays home
items.text: What you say is understood on the device itself whenever possible.

items.title: Real privacy
items.text: Your data travels encrypted and your keys never leave your account.

cta.title: Start talking to your home.
cta.text: Create your account and pair your first device.

footer.tagline: Your home, with a voice of its own.

web3.title: Cents instead of subscriptions.
web3.intro: Every service has a tiny, visible price. Your account comes with its own wallet on the Solana network: every payment is recorded and you can check it anytime. You never sign anything weird.

pay.title: Wallet included, no weird keys
pay.text: Nomik takes care of signing for you. You never touch a key.

pay.title: Everything gets recorded
pay.text: Every payment is written to a public network. What, when and how much, always in view.

pay.title: Pay-per-use pricing, always upfront
pay.text: You see the price before every service: a lookup, a tool, a transfer. No surprises.

web3.appsText: Nomik talks to your tools over MCP, an open standard: the store, inventory, bookings or your content. Every installed app adds its skills to the assistant, and every lookup pays cents.
web3.flowTitle: From “hello” to done, step by step.

flow.title: You talk
flow.text: Say what you need, in your own words.

flow.title: Understands
flow.text: Reads the request and plans the steps.

flow.title: Verifies
flow.text: Checks every step and asks your permission.

flow.title: Delivers
flow.text: Runs it and shows you the result.

contracts.title: Contracts that enforce themselves.
contracts.text: Important agreements live as smart contracts on Solana: programs that carry out the deal to the letter, with no middlemen. Money only moves when the work is done, and anyone can verify it.

business.title: One system for every machine.
business.intro: NomikOS gives every machine what it needs to work: ears to hear you, hands to act, and a wallet to pay for its services. At home it's your assistant; at your company, your workforce. One account that grows with you, from person to organization.

cases.title: Your home, alive
cases.text: The assistant, the cleaning robot and every corner obey your voice and coordinate on their own.

cases.title: Smart buildings
cases.text: Install it in a building and every apartment turns smart for its renter: access, climate and pay-per-use services.

cases.title: Tireless workers
cases.text: Agent fleets that serve, sell and solve 24/7, with spending caps and full oversight.

economy.title: An economy that runs itself.
economy.text: You set the budget once. Agents pay cents for every service they use —a lookup, a tool, a delivery— and every move is recorded end to end, all the way to the final customer.

steps.title: Sign up in 1 click
steps.text: Join with your email or usual account. Your wallet is created invisibly behind the scenes: no seed phrases, no weird keys.

steps.title: Add funds and limits
steps.text: Top up once and set a daily cap. Like credits in your favorite apps, with optional auto top-up.

steps.title: Watch it work
steps.text: Every task lands in your history in real time, with its cost in cents. Anything over your limit is blocked instantly.

sandbox.title: Sandbox mode: play without fear.
sandbox.text: Try the full system on your devices with play money. Break things, reset and start over, without spending a real cent.
